worldBackground: This is a world of six continents arrayed around a great inland sea, where ambition and raw capability are the only currencies that matter. The Hunter Association grants licenses to those rare enough to earn one—a credential that confers legal immunity and access to forbidden knowledge, yet demands a staggering price in the yearly examination where most candidates never return alive. Nen, a discipline of channeling one's life force into superhuman feats, is the open secret of the trained few; the masses remain blissfully unaware that such power exists, guarded by an elite who prefer mystery to panic. A hidden mafia ecosystem of Ten Dons rules the underworld's black markets in artifacts and influence, while the Zoldyck family of Kukuroo Mountain remains the world's most storied assassin dynasty—a tourist attraction no visitor has ever successfully infiltrated. The scavenger haven of Meteor City shelters the stateless in a web of shadows and survival. Towers like Heavens Arena offer blood sport to the desperate and famous; auction seasons in great cities like Yorknew draw the powerful to bid on wonders and horrors alike. Yet beneath the veneer of civilization lurks a world that has never fully been charted: magical beasts of fearsome strength roam the unexplored frontiers; rumors whisper among the powerful of continents and dangers beyond the known maps. This is a realm where strength writes the law, wonder and brutality walk hand in hand, and every frontier holds the promise of fortune or death—or both.
